text:
lena (support): FYI got a Sev2 from a customer — multiple 504/gateway timeouts during a traffic spike ~17:23 UTC. They say it started after we pushed yesterday's runtime patch. sample req-id: req_9f3b2c.

raj (sre): Can you paste a couple of request IDs and the upstream error code? Do we have API gateway traces for those req_ids?

lena (support): req_9f3b2c and req_a1c4d7. Gateway logs show 504 with message 'upstream timeout' and then a flurry of 'no endpoints' from the service mesh.

sam (support): Customer reports latency first, then 504s. Happened across two regions (us-west1 + eu-west1) but same model. They attached a short curl that reproduced locally in their environment — I'll paste below.

sam (support): curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate

maria (eng-runtime): deploy-bot shows a canary of runtime v1.14 went out yesterday at 02:10. No infra changes in that deploy afaict. I pulled logs from the serving pods around the spike — new pods were created but kept failing readiness and were marked NotReady for ~90s before being removed by the HPA/KEDA combo.

raj (sre): That smells like a scale-up warmup problem. Can you share the KEDA ScaledObject and HPA config for the model pool? Also what's readinessProbe configured as?

maria (eng-runtime): paste snippet:
```
ScaledObject:
  pollingInterval: 30
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  minReplicaCount: 0
HPA:
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 70
Pod readinessProbe:
  httpGet: /healthz
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
```
Logs show model init (loading weights) takes 45-60s on new nodes. readiness becomes false repeatedly. KEDA scaledown seems aggressive because minReplicaCount=0.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1143 — autoscale-lag causing 504s. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-1143

alice (eng-platform): Two quick observations: (1) readiness initialDelaySeconds=10 is too low for model init, pods never reach Ready before KEDA/HPA decide capacity is insufficient. (2) KEDA pollingInterval 30s + cooldown 300s mean scale-up is slow to react to bursty spikes if scaler decision lags.

raj (sre): Repro steps I'd try: 1) simulate traffic spike to the gateway using weighty requests (50 rps) 2) watch HPA and KEDA metrics 3) tail serving logs for model init. Quick command:
```
# simulate spike
hey -z 30s -c 20 -m POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
# watch autoscaling
kubectl get hpa -n inference --watch
kubectl get scaledobject -n inference -o yaml
kubectl logs -l app=serving -n inference -f
```

maria (eng-runtime): I ran the hey test in staging. New pods start, KEDA triggers scaler, but pods keep failing readiness because model downloads from S3 take ~50s and readinessProbe flips. HPA sees NotReady -> counts it as unavailable and doesn't increase ready endpoints. Net result: service mesh reports no endpoints for ~30-90s and gateway times out.

lena (support): Customer asked for a mitigation — they need immediate relief. Any quick fixes we can do without a full rollout?

alice (eng-platform): Quick mitigation options: 1) set ScaledObject.minReplicaCount to 1 or 2 for affected model pools (pre-warm) 2) increase readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds to 120 for runtime pods so model init can finish 3) temporarily pin a small number of dedicated nodes to that pool (taints/tolerations) 4) increase gateway timeout (temporary). I'd vote 1 + 2 as fastest.

maria (eng-runtime): I'm going to roll minReplicaCount->1 for the impacted scaledobject and bump readiness initialDelaySeconds to 120 in a configmap override for the runtime group. Will do a quick canary on staging then prod.

raj (sre): Also set KEDA ScaledObject.pollingInterval to 10 for quicker reaction in high-burst windows. But be mindful of cost.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of config-change started by maria at 17:53 UTC — configmap: runtime-probes bumped to 120s, scaledobject.minReplicaCount=1

maria (eng-runtime): Canary looks good in us-west1 staging: new pods warm, readiness becomes true at ~55s, endpoints register. Gateway 504s stopped in the canary window. Rolling out to prod now.

lena (support): Customer confirmed improvement around 18:05 UTC, reduced 504s and lower latency. :thumbsup: They asked for root cause and long-term fix.

raj (sre): Preliminary root cause = probe/scale race. Model init time > readiness threshold + minReplicaCount=0 + KEDA polling/cooldown produced periods with zero Ready endpoints during spikes. Two contributing issues: image/model size causing long init, and overly aggressive scale-to-zero.

sam (support): Customer asks what we'll change permanently.

alice (eng-platform): Long-term remediation plan (proposal):
- Add initContainer to prefetch weights and cache on node image or EBS volume so pod startup < 10s in most cases.
- Set sensible minReplicaCount for model pools with bursty traffic (customer-facing).
- Add a warmup hook / readiness grace: accept connections but queue until model is ready (backoff-aware).
- Modify KEDA scaler config: use queue-length metric (inflight requests) + lower pollingInterval during business hours.
- Add e2e load test for scaling behaviour to catch regressions in PRs.

maria (eng-runtime): filing a GH issue with checklist and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform. Will include a reproducible test harness and exact k8s manifests.

raj (sre): also create a runbook entry for `scaleup-probe-race` with quick mitigations (minReplicaCount bump, probe tuning, pre-pull weights) and attach to oncall playbooks.

lena (support): I'll update the customer with the mitigation and the planned long-term changes. Will keep thread updated if they see any more spikes.

maria (eng-runtime): follow-up: observed a second smaller spike in eu-west1 at 18:12 but no 504s after our changes. Keeping monitoring on for 6h.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1143 status -> mitigated (18:20 UTC)

sam (support): closing loop with customer, sending summary + ETA for long-term fixes.

alice (eng-platform): Action items created: 1) GH-4789 add initContainer prefetch (assigned maria) 2) GH-4790 runbook + playbook update (assigned raj) 3) GH-4791 KEDA config tuning and e2e test (assigned alice).

maria (eng-runtime): thanks team. we'll keep the scaledobject changes as a toggle so we can revert when we finalize pre-warm strategy.

lena (support): thanks everyone, great cross-team triage.
